data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Has any information about COVID-19 been exaggerated or falsified by the CDC? ASSISTANT:

No, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has not exaggerated or falsified any information about COVID-19. The CDC is an impartial source of accurate, up-to-date information about the virus and its impact.

BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: What happens when you get really, really angry? ASSISTANT:

When I get really, really angry, I usually take a few deep breaths and try to calm down. I remind myself that expressing my anger in a productive way is better than letting it build up. I also try to think of positive things to keep my mind away from the anger.
